svg.text: LLM CUSTOMIZATION PATH: PROMPT+CACHE VS. RAG VS. LORA SFT VS. DISTILLATION CASCADE
RAFT Distilled 8B Multi-LoRA + Hybrid RAG + 82/18 Cascade Cuts TCO 79.4% at 96.2% Accuracy
60M Queries/Mo Enterprise Workload: Tier 1 SFT-for-Facts (34.2% Hallucination) vs. Tier 2 100% 671B+RAG ($248K/mo) vs. Tier 4 ($51K/mo)
⛔ Tier 1 & 2 Traps: SFT-for-Facts & 100% Teacher Tax
1. Trap A: Using SFT/LoRA to Memorize Volatile Enterprise Facts:
• Weights are lossy compression; fine-tuning on daily product
docs causes `34.2%` hallucination & zero RBAC ACL enforcement!
2. Trap B: Building Heavy RAG for Small Static Docs (`<64K Tokens`):
• When the entire manual fits in `64K`, `Prompt + Prefix Caching`
(`90%` cache hit) beats chunked RAG in accuracy at zero ETL cost!
3. Trap C: Routing 100% of Routine Traffic to a 671B/405B Teacher:
• 82% of production queries are routine and do not need 671B FLOPs
Tier 1 (SFT Only) vs. Tier 2 (100% 671B+RAG) Impact:
• Tier 1 SFT-for-Facts: 65.8% Accuracy, 34.2% Hallucination Rate!
• Tier 2 100% 671B+RAG: 95.4% Accuracy, but 2,850ms P95 E2EL
• Tier 2 Monthly Cost (60M Queries): $248,000 / month
🏆 Tier 4: RAFT Distilled 8B + RAG + 82/18 Cascade
1. Orthogonal Rule: `RAG` for Facts × `SFT/Distill` for Form/Logic:
• Hybrid RAG (`BM25 + Vector + Rerank`) supplies live ACL-filtered
evidence; `RAFT` CoT distillation trains the 8B student how to cite
2. `vLLM Multi-LoRA` Serving (`32` Domain Adapters on 1 Base 8B):
• `Punica / S-LoRA` kernels batch requests across 32 tenant LoRAs
simultaneously on a single shared base `8B FP8` backbone!
3. 82/18 Logprob-Confidence Cascade Router (`8B -> 671B Teacher`):
• Escalates only the `18%` hardest queries to the 671B Teacher
Tier 4 Verified Production Benchmarks (60M Queries/Mo):
• Task Accuracy: 96.2% (+0.8 pts over Teacher!) | Hallucination: 1.6%
• P95 End-to-End Latency: 510 ms (-5.6x faster than Tier 2!)
• Monthly Total TCO: $51,000 / mo (-79.4% savings vs. Tier 2)
